title: Notation spec: Chess algebraic (SAN)
description:
Chess Standard Algebraic Notation for the notation adapter.

## Piece symbols
K=King, Q=Queen, R=Rook, B=Bishop, N=Knight, pawn=empty string

## Move format
{piece}{disambiguation}{capture}{destination}{promotion}{check}

Examples: e4, Nf3, Bxc6, Rae1, R1e1, e8=Q, O-O, O-O-O, Qh4#

## Grid labels
files: a-h (col 0-7), ranks: 1-8 (row 0-7)

## Disambiguation
When two pieces of the same type can reach the destination:
1. Add source file if unique (Rae1)
2. Add source rank if file ambiguous (R1e1)
3. Add both if needed (Qa3b4 — rare)
Resolved by filtering legal moves that match destination.

## Capture marker
"x" between piece and destination: Bxc6, exd5 (pawn captures include source file)

## Special moves
- O-O → castle kingside
- O-O-O → castle queenside
- e8=Q → promotion (= + target piece letter)

## Annotations
+ = check, # = checkmate (output only, not needed for input parsing)

## Declarative spec
```json
"notation": {
  "piece_symbols": {"king":"K","queen":"Q","rook":"R","bishop":"B","knight":"N","pawn":""},
  "capture_marker": "x",
  "disambiguation": "file_then_rank",
  "promotion_marker": "=",
  "check_marker": "+",
  "checkmate_marker": "#",
  "special_moves": {
    "O-O": {"action_type":"castle","side":"kingside"},
    "O-O-O": {"action_type":"castle","side":"queenside"}
  }
}
```
Fully covered by declarative spec — no WASM needed.
